items.title: 12.2.3 Ammonium salts se ammonia ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.2.3 with Figure 12.3, printed page 275.

blocks.text: Laboratory mein ammonia gas ammonium chloride jaise ammonium salt ko calcium hydroxide jaise base ke saath garam kar ke banai jati hai (Figure 12.3): 2NH4Cl(s) + Ca(OH)2 se CaCl2 + 2H2O(l) + 2NH3(g) (print salt ko NaCl likhti hai). Is acid-base reaction mein NH4+ H+ de kar acid aur OH- use qubool kar ke base ka kaam karta hai; reaction ammonium salt se ammonia gas nikal deta hai aur salt aur pani chhorta hai. Yeh salt analysis mein ammonium pehchanne ke liye aam istemal hota hai: teez boo wali gas jo geele surkh litmus paper ko neela kare compound mein ammonium batati hai.

blocks.alt: NH4Cl aur Ca(OH)2 wali test tube, munh thora neeche jhuka kar clamp ki gayi, burner se garam hoti hai. Delivery tube gas ko quicklime (CaO) ke dhelon se bhare drying tower ke neeche le jati hai. Khushk ammonia oopar se nikal kar ulte gas jar mein jama hoti hai kyunke hawa se halki hai; jar ke munh par geela surkh litmus neela ho jata hai. Equation: 2NH4Cl + Ca(OH)2 -> CaCl2 + 2H2O + 2NH3.
blocks.caption: Laboratory mein ammonia gas banana (Figure 12.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Kisan ko ammonium fertiliser aur chuna (lime) ek saath khet mein nahi dalna chahiye. Kyun, aur kaun sa reaction hota hai (Quick Check 12.1c)?
blocks.explanation: Chuna base hai (CaO ya Ca(OH)2); ammonium sulfate ke saath woh nitrogen ko ammonia gas ke taur par chhorta hai, jo ur jati hai: (NH4)2SO4 + Ca(OH)2 se CaSO4 + 2H2O + 2NH3. Fertiliser ki nitrogen fasal ko milne ke bajaye hawa mein zaya ho jati hai.

items: Ammonium salt ko base ke saath garam karein: 2NH4Cl + Ca(OH)2 se CaCl2 + 2H2O + 2NH3; NH4+ acid, OH- base; teez boo wali gas jo geela surkh litmus neela kare ammonium ki pehchan hai.
